display_long_description:
Are you looking for a VR Action RPG?

Legendary Tales is a full-scale VR action RPG designed to deliver deep progression, physical combat, and true cooperative adventure. Built exclusively for immersive VR, every action is controlled by your own movement, from weapon swings to spellcasting.

# Physics
[media]

# Combat
[media]
Engage in intense physics-based combat where weapons have real weight, momentum, and collision. Swing swords, block attacks with shields, fire arrows, or unleash magic. 

# Skill
[media]
Progress your character through a deep skill tree system that allows you to define your own playstyle. Specialize as a warrior, rogue, mage, or create hybrid builds by freely combining skills. Every choice shapes how you fight and survive.


# Dungeon
[media]
# Discover item
[media]
Explore dangerous dungeons filled with enemies, traps, and powerful loot. Items are generated with random attributes, ensuring that every run feels fresh and rewarding. Discover rare gear, optimize your build, and continuously chase better equipment.

# Crafting
[media]
Crafting plays a key role in your journey. Collect materials, craft weapons and improve your gear to prepare for tougher challenges ahead. 

# Multiplay
[media]
Legendary Tales can be played solo or in online co-op with friends. Team up to clear dungeons together, coordinate attacks in real time, share loot, and experience full physics-based combat in multiplayer. Cooperation, communication, and synergy turn each adventure into a memorable story.
